reviews.comment: The professor is engaging and passionate about the material. While the lectures can be dense, attending class and using resources like unstuckstudy make studying more manageable. Exams are challenging but extra credit opportunities help. Overall, a rewarding course.

Dr. D is one of the best profs at a&m! He is super nice and offers lots of help. No hw. Grade based on tests and small assignments. Very lecture heavy so pls do not miss class and pay attention. Topics can be confusing. Attendance is also required.

reviews.comment: A horrific creature not meant for the eyes of man nor the minds of the coldest caliber. Dr. Don Conlee is less a man and more a beast of unbounded energy and will, appearing at times least expected. His quizzes are easy and he outlines his expectations for tests and offers solutions to struggling students. Overall, 9/10.

He was a good professor but lectures were boring and followed the slides he posts. Attendance is graded and worth 15% of final grade. During test reviews he straight up tells you exactly what you need to know and what's on the exams. Study what he says and you will be fine. Don't bother reading the textbook. Overall, I recommend!

He's disorganized. He does not upgrade grades in Canvas so you will need to calculate it yourself. Exams make up 85% of ur grade. This is not an easy A class. Go to class or you will be lost. He as a person is super funny and caring. Some extra credit is offered. Posted a lecture a day before our final over material that would be on the final.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: You have to come to class as much as possible because iClicker is 15% of the grade. The tests are very conceptual, so if you just memorize the material, you won't do well. He is super funny and wants his students to really understand and put in the work to get an A. He offers extra credit for each exam for people who are struggling.
Dr. Conlee is amazing. It's like having a class taught by Santa Claus.

He was overall passionate in his lectures and really cared that you knew the material. I would recommend getting the textbook for extra study material because the exams can be challenging if you only go off the slides. He does extra credit for exams, but make sure you go to class because he does iClicker grades.

Overall, good class! Only grades are 4 exams and extra credit assignments, so study hard for every exam. He clearly cares about the material, and I enjoyed the class. Make sure you go to class because he does attendance iClickers! Not an easy A, so make sure you are doing the work and taking notes during lectures.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great prof. Cared about his students. Attendance was not mandatory but made up 10% of your grade. Exams are straight forward and he gives lots of tips what to study for for the exam. Not a weather major but I found the material interesting and enjoyed the class. Exams can be long but he gives so many extra credit stuff it's almost criminal.

I enjoyed having Conlee as a professor. His lectures went along with his tests and there are extra credit opportunities. He makes funny comments during class and cares for his students. No homework, mostly iclicker questions and multiple-choice tests. Great class if you need science credits for computer science.
strict, approachable, understanding

reviews.comment: Dr. Conlee was a pretty good professor. My ATMO 201 class was all lecture and iClicker questions sprinkled in between. It can get boring, but he offers good extra credit opportunities and always seemed open to help when I need. I would recommend.

One of my favorite teachers. Go to his office hours and he'll be your best friend. Tests are hard but not impossible if you study his powerpoints. If you can, write directly on his powerpoints so you don't miss any information.

Dr. Conlee is such an amazing professor! He really cares about students, and as long as you communicate and are honest he will help you out as much as possible. The tests seem a little scary at first but it really isn't all that bad as long as you understand the concepts really well.

Dr. D is amazing. He clearly loves what he does and makes learning the material far more enjoyable. Grades are just attendance, 3 exams, and a final. Dr. D clearly has a passion for weather which makes him an enjoyable professor to take. reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

Dr. D is by far one of the best professors I've ever had at TAMU. His grading is mostly based on 3 exams and the Final and they're fairly difficult so study. Dr. Conlee's lessons are fun and interesting. He cares a lot about his student's grades. He gives lots of extra credit opportunities. You should definitely attend every single class as he takes participation points and his lectures literally parallel the content of the tests.

Professor Conlee is a funny, caring professor. You should definitely come in for office hours if you're struggling! He will help you and guide you to make a good grade in his class! reviews.comment: I find it funny that every time I see anything related to the weather on the news I realize just how much I have learned from this class. Don Conlee is probably one of the best professors I have ever had. He is very well informed on the subject that he is teaching. Very fun and entertaining if you take interest in the subject. LOTS of Extra Credit!

This class is really interesting and fun. It does take a little bit of work to maintain an A but that is expected in all university level classes. Dr. Conlee is very dynamic in his lectures and very open to questions. Reading the textbook is helpful in making A's on the tests. And don't be afraid to use office hours if you have any questions.

This class is the first challenging class you'll take as a meteorology major. That being said, it is completely doable. The hardest part is just understanding some of the complex equations you'll need to learn, but Dr. Conlee really wants his students to succeed and he is very helpful in office hours. Such an awesome professor! His lectures are interesting, and overall he adds his spark to it to make it enjoyable!

Prof. Conlee is my favorite prof I've ever had at TAMU if you are considering taking ATMO 201 for sure take him he's hilarious, super friendly, and gives out a chance for five points back on every exam. Dr. Conlee is a great professor, you can tell that he loves what he does and knows what he is talking about. He is a pretty funny guy and he knows his stuff. You do have to study for tests to make As so if you dont want to put the effort in consider taking another class.

Difficult intro course for non-science majors. Conlee casually talks in complex terms & tends to gloss over concepts that he says are "important". reviews.comment: Dr. Conlee is a super passionate prof who loves meteorology and is very knowledgeable it. Tests can be difficult, but if you take the time to read the textbook and understand concepts, an A is very achievable.

Dr. Conlee is one of my favorite professors. He's very nice, very funny, and he really cares about what he teaches. His only drawback is he's not the best at explaining difficult concepts. He's always available in office hours though and there is help deks if you ever need it. He helped reinforce that I chose the right major.

Love Dr. D!! I was prepared to dread ATMO but I found myself actually wanting to go to class. He is so personable and humorous and always made class fun with all of his dad jokes. Gives out lots of extra credit opportunities (5-10 points for each exam) which bumped my B up to an A. Take him!!

Very funny prof, always made lectures fun. Tests were hard, but doable with preparation. Is very forgiving and gives out loads of extra credit. Go to class, pay attention, and study and you'll be fine.

Conlee is a great professor, very lively and funny. Is intolerant of cheating, and did change our 3rd exam to fill in the blank because someone had been cheating off an old exam. Horrible lecturer, and thats the only thing he does. Probably the worst professor Ive ever had. Im a 4.0 student, but am anticipating a C in his class. Would highly recommend avoiding this class for the sake of your gpa and sanity.

reviews.comment: Do not take Don Conlee for anything. Ever. For our third test (3 out of 4 which were the only grades) he made it completely short answer and if you spell any word wrong the entire question was wrong. He decided to change it to this from multiple choice the day before the test because "too many people did better on test 2 than test 1." DO NOT TAKE.

He makes the class so interesting and takes time to know each of his students. The material could be hard but he does his best to explain it for everyone to understand. He is by far my favorite professor. But don't even think about not coming to lectures, your grade will be affected if you skip.
His class is difficult if you don't show up to class and pay attention but he offers plenty of extra credit and is a good lecturer.

reviews.comment: good teacher, just study hard

Dr. Conlee is a great guy and attempts to crack jokes to lighten the mood but his class is pretty tough. A lot of it is conceptual and he doesn't go into detail at all. He takes attendance through iClicker. He'll never let you out early, instead you will watch YouTube weather videos until the class ends and you have to click out before you leave.

Dr. Conlee was a very nice and respectful person. His class was medium difficulty usually because his tests had some trickier questions on it. Usually questions with some sort of ambiguity or fill in the blank that made sure you knew the subject. He was funny and his lectures weren't too bad. No need for the book, go to lecture and you'll make a B.
Dr. D was one of my favorite professors this semester.  He makes the course interesting and fun and truly seems to care about his students.

It is easy to tell that Dr. Conlee is passionate about weather and wants others to be just as excited. His lectures were fun and the material was engaging. His humorous approach to the class made it all the more enjoyable. Dr. Conlee wanted the students to succeed, so he provided a lot of bonus. A very personable prof. I highly recommend him.

Dr. D is one of the best profs I have had at A&M. He truly loves weather and is passionate about what he teaches. Tests can be difficult. This isn't the easiest life and physical science, but it also isn't the hardest. The final is basically old test questions, and he gave extra credit after every test. Be sure to go to class to get iClicker points

Dr. Conlee is a great guy. He tries to make class entertaining and is really passionate about the weather. His tests aren't the easiest, but he does give a  lot of extra credit to help you out. It does take him a while to get grades back and he doesn't post them to eCampus. You have to use your iclicker everyday for attendance.
He's very passionate about the material and super interesting. He really likes his students and his work and is super generous about extra credit.

3 exams and a cumulative final.  Took this class thinking it'd be a blow off but turned out it's not. Totally do-able still but you'll need to work for a good grade. He gives a lot of chances for extra credit on the exams which is good. Lectures are long but he tries to keep them interesting.

He is a great professor! I enjoyed every moment of his class. That being said, this is not the easiest nor the hardest class I have ever taken. His lessons are straightforward and there are three tests, one final, and plenty of opportunity for bonus. Prepare for a challenge but also prepare to learn a lot that will stick with you for life.

Dr. D is such an amazing prof. He is funny and always jokes around. There is quite a bit of material. It is not the easiest but its not hard either. He takes attendance with the iclicker so attendance is kinda mandatory. Such an amazing guy, i would take him again!

Dr. Conlee is an AWESOME professor. I would highly recommend him. He is  funny and makes the content fun. The material itself isn't hard, but it isn't easy. The best professor I've had by far. Made my mornings, he also makes a lot of funny jokes. I would definitely take him again, and highly recommend you take him, you will NOT be disappointed.

Dr. Conlee is a super nice guy. He is very funny and that shows during his lectures. There are three tests plus a cumulative final exam. You would have to study for the tests. Sometimes they can be pretty specific and a little hard, but if you study hard you can pass this class with an A.

Dr. D is a really cool guy. As long as you go to lecture the book is not needed. The class itself is basic laws of science and only is hard if you over think the concepts. Just go to class and it will be an easy B without studying.

Dr. Conlee is a pretty awesome teacher! I have always struggled taking tests so I had to read the book to help me understand. I didn't do very well on my first test and he was extremely encouraging and helpful. He is very approachable. His tests can be a tad tricky, but if you study hard and know the concepts you will do great!

Dr.D (Dr. Conlee) always makes class entertaining, he's basically a stand up guy when he lectures. Explanations are pretty clear and if you have a question he is more than happy to help, even outside of class. You mostly work on computers for the lab, but you sometimes go outside to use equipment. If you can, take Dr.D.

Dr. D is clearly a smart man who knows his stuff. He's always willing to help and explain something if you don't understand. I do have to caution against his testing style though, it makes me want to pull my hair out. His tests consist of lots of fill in the blank questions and problems you actually work through. Besides that you'll love him.
